turns.text: Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: billing | bug | account | data. Ticket: 'The packing checklist takes nearly two minutes to load every morning, but it always loads in the end.' Reply with the label only.

For the desk records, the labeling rubric: crashes, freezes, and wrong outputs are bug; charges and invoices are billing; login and access problems are account; stale content is data. Additionally, slow-but-working behavior gets the label perf - do not use bug when the feature works and is merely slow. Note the rubric in one line.
New shift at the help desk. The ticket queue is open; the standing rubric applies. Confirm in one line.
